title: Unit 10 Consolidation
goal: Review past counterfactuals, hubiera in the result, regrets and reproaches, conditions without si and hubiera without si, and read a text about Mario Vargas Llosa and Conversación en La Catedral.

items: Review si hubiera and habría for a past that did not happen.
Review hubiera in the result clause, regrets and reproaches, and conditions without si.
Review hubiera without si and aun cuando hubiera.
Read a text about the writer Mario Vargas Llosa and his novel Conversación en La Catedral.
I can say what would have happened with si hubiera and habría or hubiera and a past participle.
I can express a regret or a reproach with debería haber, tendría que haber and me arrepiento de.
I can state a condition without si with de and an infinitive or a gerund, and with hubiera at the start.
I can read a short text about Mario Vargas Llosa and his novel Conversación en La Catedral.
